draft.summary: Show a low-stock alert on the kitchen screen
draft.description:
## Context
Type: Story (created as Task; this Jira project has no Story type).

Butter ran out twice this month in the morning rush and croissants stopped. The kitchen manager only noticed when the shelf was empty.

## User Story
As the kitchen manager, I want to be alerted when an ingredient falls below its minimum, so that I notice before it runs out.

## Acceptance Criteria
- AC1: **Ingredient below its minimum** (Happy path) — An ingredient's daily count is below the minimum set for it. Expected: the kitchen screen shows a red badge for that ingredient.
- AC2: **Minimum per ingredient** (Happy path) — The kitchen manager or one of her assistants sets a minimum for an ingredient. Expected: the minimum applies to that ingredient only.
- AC3: **Who can change a minimum** (Negative case) — A user who is not the kitchen manager or one of her two assistants tries to change a minimum. Expected: the minimum is not changed.

## Business Rules
The minimum is set per ingredient. Only the kitchen manager and her two assistants can change it. The alert uses the daily count already entered.

## References, Risks and Dependencies
Risk: the alert is only as current as the end-of-day count and can be a day late. Deferred: automatic counts from supplier invoices (00:03:34) and automatic supplier orders (00:08:15), with no commitment.

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Acceptance criteria met.
- [ ] Developer testing and sanity check completed.
- [ ] Peer review approved.
- [ ] QA validation approved.
- [ ] Demo completed.
- [ ] Documentation updated, if applicable.
- [ ] Release status and evidence recorded.
